deploy-bot: Proposing temporary runtime pin to v2.20.0-compat on api-prod for 45m (02:15-03:00 PT) to mitigate p99 tail spike seen in canary after kernel micropatch. Ticket INF-5102. Tagging @eng-runtime and @ops.

eric: Can you drop the canary perf snapshot and exact ids so I can brief PMs?

maya: Who will own rollback if pin doesn't stabilize things? Need runbook.

zhang: Canary id canary-20260412-a. p99: 480ms -> 920ms post-patch. median: 40ms -> 43ms. Error-rate unchanged. Looks like tail-only regress. Recommend trying routing to `stable-narrow` variant if pin doesn't fix it.

ops: I can run rollback during window. Runbook snippet: ```# rollback runtime image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.19.7
# drain and warmup cache
./scripts/drain_nodes.sh --pool api-prod && ./scripts/warmup_prefix_cache.sh --model stable-narrow
# healthcheck
curl -sS https://api-prod.internal/health || echo "health failed"```

eric: I'll own telemetry. Auto-rollback rule: if p99 average over 3 consecutive 1m windows >10% above baseline, ops executes rollback. Also suppress autoscaling on runtime while we observe.

deploy-bot: Pin scheduled at 02:15 PT. Will post status on execution.

deploy-bot: Pin applied at 02:18 PT: runtime pinned to v2.20.0-compat on api-prod. Post-pin p99=506ms (within acceptable delta). No rollback triggered during window. Closing ticket INF-5102 with follow-up to add note to release-notes and remind partners to watch for any regressions.
